name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 4px #005fcc outer ring with a 2px white inner ring for focus indicators. This gives high visibility on all backgrounds while keeping the ring compact enough to avoid clutter. The trade-off is slightly larger focus rings on high-contrast modes, but the clarity for keyboard users outweighs the visual bulk.

name: Reader
text: The 4px #005fcc ring risks failing on patterned backgrounds where the white inner ring blends into the pattern, creating a "floating" focus indicator. A 3px solid #fff ring with a 1px #005fcc outer ring keeps the focus visible without relying on background contrast, solving the pattern issue while maintaining WCAG compliance. Test both against a high-contrast patterned background to settle it.
